description: Bibliographic data for one published patent — title, inventors, applicants, publication date, IPC classifications. Drawn from EPO DOCDB, which covers 100+ patent offices, so Chinese, Japanese, Korean, US and PCT/WO publications resolve as well as European ones. A PCT international application (a "WO" publication number) is answered the same as any other — this is NOT the International Search Report or Written Opinion, which EPO OPS does not carry at all; for those, go to WIPO PATENTSCOPE (patentscope.wipo.int). Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code such as the "A" in "CN117928705A" is handled for you.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed.

name: get_biblio
